major_additive_decisions: Caller-scoped request idempotency uses canonical semantic replay equivalence.
Per-request monotonic fencing and checked operational projections prevent stale authoritative writes.
Attempt events, attempt artifacts, run inputs, and canonical result manifests close execution lineage.
Observation availability requires explicit evidence or conservative retrieval-time fallback.
Derivation creation, lineage, PIT propagation, and temporal recomputation are deterministic and atomic.
Research, LLM, setup, eligibility, lifecycle, and outcome policies have immutable artifact-backed identities.
Trade events preserve raw-to-interpreted evidence and exact quantity conservation.
Legacy, Challenge, Experiment, and evaluator semantics are defined while their implementation may be deferred.
semantic_change_rule: Any semantic change after this freeze requires a new specification version.
supersession_scope: Supersedes V1.0.0 only where this amendment adds or clarifies missing semantics.
